relevance_note: Single case report of a 28-year-old woman diagnosed with LCAT deficiency by renal biopsy and plasma LCAT activity ("who was finally diagnosed with LCAT deficiency"); no LCAT genetic testing or variant is reported, so she is in scope by diagnosis only.
method_note: Read the full paper by hand; JSON assembled with a short script in the scratch directory, every span checked verbatim against the paper. One in-scope person (rule 5 label 'patient'). No genetic testing is reported and no LCAT variant is tied to the patient, so the variants table is empty and n_patients_reported is null (one patient with an enzymatic/biopsy diagnosis, zero with a reported variant). The diagnosis is stated as 'LCAT deficiency', not 'familial'; the Introduction notes an acquired form secondary to liver disorder, and liver function tests were normal, but the paper never states congenital/familial origin; family history 'insignificant'. Possible inconsistency: the Case Presentation reports 'normal HDL-C (63 mg/dl)' and the title/conclusion say normal HDL-C, while the Discussion says 'low to normal HDL-C'; recorded low HDL cholesterol as excluded from the explicit 'normal HDL-C' statements. 'low esterified cholesterol' (Discussion) recorded as an observed feature, but the checklist item 'reduced cholesteryl ester fraction' left not reported because no fraction/ratio is given. 'Tubules showed moderate degeneration' recorded as a feature; not mapped to 'tubular atrophy or interstitial fibrosis'. Foamy histiocytes are discussed only in general, not for this patient. Normal findings recorded as excluded abnormalities per D-27 (Coombs, autoantibodies, C3/C4, liver function tests, LDH, PT, PTT); 'Ophthalmic examination including fundoscopy was unremarkable' recorded as written (abnormal ophthalmic examination, excluded). Age 28 years is the age at admission/report; no separate age at onset or diagnosis is given (edema 'since 4 months' before admission; onset_iso8601 left null because it is a duration before admission, not an age). Serum albumin 2.5 g/dl, BUN and creatinine values are printed without an abnormal/normal statement and were not recorded as features. The Discussion says the patient was treated 'with lipid lowering agents and angiotensin converting enzyme inhibitors', while the Case Presentation names gemfibrozil, atorvastatin and telmisartan; the treatment summary uses the Case Presentation wording. The reference list in the Markdown repeats each reference twice with shifted numbering (conversion artifact); no references were needed.
